name: trec_server_transfer_protocol_v1
purpose: Independent six-class client-to-server transfer benchmark for the training-only trust endpoint.

test_access_history.before_freeze: The source file was downloaded, hashed, and line-counted for feasibility; no TREC model prediction or aggregate performance metric existed.
test_access_history.instrumentation_smokes_before_final_free: Seed 241 anchor/routed and seed 242 anchor development jobs ran while audit fields were being repaired; an initial seed 243 routed job then exposed an infeasible per-class quota under globally assigned contamination. These artifacts are invalidated. The scientific ratios, models, steps, and router threshold were not tuned; contamination placement was corrected to deterministic class-balanced apportionment before the complete development matrix and any official evaluation.
test_access_history.development_rule: Development runs must not open, parse, tokenize, or evaluate the official-test file.
test_access_history.official_rule: After implementation and development sanity checks, all predeclared official seeds and both primary comparators are reported regardless of direction.

development.role: Implementation, finite-loss, payload-simplex, and routing sanity only; no hyperparameter or comparator selection.
development.advance_rule: Run the official matrix after both comparators complete all three seeds with finite metrics and all audit invariants passing, regardless of which comparator is better.

official_evaluation.analysis: Report every seed and the paired routed-minus-anchor mean. Use a two-sided paired Student-t interval and test across the five seed differences; the interval describes seed variation only, not test-sample or task-population uncertainty.
official_evaluation.direction_policy: Report and interpret the result regardless of sign; no success threshold is used to suppress a negative or null result.

evidence_boundaries: TREC's published data license is recorded as unknown.
The 500-example official test has 0.2 percentage-point accuracy resolution and limited statistical power.
The ABBR training class has only 86 raw examples, constraining balanced partitions.
Canonical probability exchange is tokenizer-agnostic at the class interface, not invariant to verbalizer tokenization.
No privacy or secure-aggregation claim is made.
Potential benchmark contamination from language-model pretraining is not ruled out.
